integrity: Mathematical proof plus reproducible finite comparison with literal graph adjacency and two distinct enumeration methods; no independent external audit and no infinite certification by finite tests.
scientific_limitations: The result covers \(K_{n,\ldots,n}\) for \(r\ge3,n\ge2\), not arbitrary unequal parts. When \((r-1)n\) is even, ordinary and strong feasibility coincide and the occupancy tightness classification is already implicit in published strong-alliance work. The all-minimal counting and upper multiplicity formulas and the odd-degree ordinary statement are the assessed contribution. Bibliographic completeness cannot be guaranteed.
title: Globally minimal defensive alliances of balanced complete multipartite graphs
